compiled_state.title: As a sprint/merge operator, hot-path scripts operate correctly under dso.workflow
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update five hot-path scripts to consume `dso.workflow` directly via `read-config.sh` instead of the four legacy config keys and the two eliminated env vars (`DSO_SPRINT_MODE`, `MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE`). Reduce `mode-detect.sh` to a one-line `read-config.sh dso.workflow` lookup. Implement the four-cell trailer behavior matrix in `check-sprint-trailer.sh` and `apply-attribution-trailers.sh`.

**Why**: This is the walking-skeleton story alongside S1 — together they prove the end-to-end pipeline works under `dso.workflow`. `mode-detect.sh` is the entry point for every sprint and merge operation; its simplification eliminates the compound-key ambiguity that caused bug `e21b-1809-eb04-477c`.

**Scope**:
- IN: `mode-detect.sh` (reduce to one-line lookup, remove legacy four-key detection); `check-sprint-trailer.sh` and `apply-attribution-trailers.sh` (4-cell behavior matrix); `merge-to-main.sh` and `merge-to-main-pr.sh` (consume `dso.workflow` directly); eliminate `DSO_SPRINT_MODE` and `MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE` env var usage; TDD tests written RED before any script change
- OUT: Skill file updates (S6), reference doc updates (S7)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `mode-detect.sh` returns the value of `read-config.sh dso.workflow` directly (one-line lookup), and the legacy four-key detection logic is removed
  ← Satisfies: SC7 (mode-detect.sh simplified)
- When this story is complete, `DSO_SPRINT_MODE` and `MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE` env vars are eliminated from all hot-path scripts; their semantics derive from `dso.workflow=ci-pr` AND the `.sprint-active` marker
  ← Satisfies: SC7 (env vars eliminated)
- When this story is complete, `check-sprint-trailer.sh` and `apply-attribution-trailers.sh` implement the four-cell behavior matrix: (1) `dso.workflow=ci-pr` + `.sprint-active` → enforce/inject; (2) `dso.workflow=ci-pr` + no `.sprint-active` → no-op; (3) `dso.workflow=local` + `.sprint-active` → no-op; (4) `dso.workflow=local` + no `.sprint-active` → no-op — all four cells covered by shell tests
  ← Satisfies: SC7 (trailer matrix)
- When this story is complete, `merge-to-main.sh` and `merge-to-main-pr.sh` consume `dso.workflow` directly via `read-config.sh` without referencing any of the four legacy config keys or the eliminated env vars
  ← Satisfies: SC7 (merge scripts updated)
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic (TDD: tests written RED before script changes)

## Considerations

- [Testing] All hot-path script changes require TDD tests written RED before any implementation change (SC requirement + blast-radius concern from epic context)
- [Reliability] `mode-detect.sh` is on the hot path for sprint and merge pipelines — incorrect `dso.workflow` value causes silent mode failure (root cause of bug `e21b-1809-eb04-477c`)
- [Consumer Impact] Before eliminating `DSO_SPRINT_MODE` and `MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE`, enumerate every consumer: hot-path scripts (in-scope), test fixtures, CI workflow env blocks (`.github/workflows/sprint-story-review.yml` named in epic context), pre-commit hooks, and any host-project overrides. For each external consumer (test, CI workflow, hook), either update it in this story or file a follow-up. Failing to do so leaves dead `${DSO_SPRINT_MODE:-}` references that silently no-op, masking mode mismatches and reintroducing the e21b-1809 failure class.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
